comments.description: This section of the JSON is not used by the repo, but instead describes this file's functionality.
comments.sdk_version: Controls the .NET SDK used by the repo. version should always be set to the current .NET 10 SDK.

comments.sdk_rollForward2: However, will always respect the .NET version specified by init.cmd (newer .NET SDKs can produce .NET 8 apps)

comments.msbuild-sdks_NoTargets2: don't actually need .NET.  These projects perform build operations like binplacing.
